description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], ATK +500 to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Fire Ability Boost, Triplecast Fire, Unlimited Fire Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Fire Abilities, Fire Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Fire Abilities; Ends after using 8 Fire abilities
TP Max: AOE Fire/NE ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: War-Awoken Searing Prominence (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
One single piercing ranged attack at True Cap Break Level 1, grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Fire Abilities to user, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if the user has at least Lv. 0/2 Attach Fire
WS Blue: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to user
WS Gold: During Tactical Awoken Mode, Fire Ability Damage +40% & Instant Fire to user
